column1: # The interface languages (D-019): every Windows 11 display language (Microsoft's "Available
# language packs for Windows": the language packs and the language interface packs), one row each.
# Read by crates/app/build.rs (picker, flags), tools/i18n/translate.py, tools/installer/build.ps1
# and tools/readme. The catalog is i18n/<code>.tsv; codes are craft-i18n's (lowercase BCP 47, as
# few subtags as Windows' tag needs to find it: sr-Latn-RS -> sr-latn, zh-TW -> zh-hant).
# flag: a lipis/flag-icons code (crates/app/assets/flags/<flag>.svg). inno: Inno Setup's official messages file
# (compiler:Languages\<inno>.isl), or - when there is none (tools/installer makes one).
# windows: Windows' own tag for the language (its LCID picks the installer language).
